abstract.t: GEVP defines a minimal protocol for epistemic convergence. Renamed from VCP to avoid collision with draft-kamimura-scitt-vcp. Invariant C_manip > C_val*2.0 as engineering heuristic. Theta 0.73 RECOMMENDED, pinned 7755f53. Architecture stable per https://github.com/GravitOpenNetwork/gravit-canon. This revision adds a formal mapping between GEVP's Epistemic State Machine and the evidence taxonomy defined in the Gravit Verifiable Epistemic Decision Standard (VEDS).
